quality_notes: Eight new official-source URLs were deduplicated against the 42-source batch 134 manifest before publication.

Energy Trends UK gas and the gas statistics collection are production, trade, demand and consumption activity evidence, not direct parcel emissions measurements.

Natural-gas methodology guidance is method evidence rather than an observed emissions row.
The 2005-2024 local and regional GHG technical report's gas-year/calendar-year and weather-correction distinctions are explicitly guarded.
The technical report's approximately 97% CO2 share for gas-combustion CO2e is retained as aggregate methodological evidence only.
